subject: Zephyr Labs: payee intake, PO field mapping & bank evidence
messages:
From: Sam Tran <sam.tran@zephyrlabs.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 15 Jan 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: New vendor: banking + PO flow questions

Hi Karthik,

Thanks for the quick intro earlier. We're ready to get Redwood set up as a payee in our ERP so we can start routing POs and remits. A couple quick items we need from your side to complete our onboarding checklist:

- Company legal name and EIN (for vendor record)
- Remittance advice format (what fields you include on invoices / remittance strings)
- Bank proof (bank letter or voided check) to satisfy treasury
- W9 or tax form for our finance team

Goal is to have your vendor live for POs by Jan 26 so our first purchase for the pilot can go through. Attaching the vendor intake template you referenced during the call.

Appreciate a point person for questions — can loop in procurement@zephyrlabs.com once we have the docs.

Best,
Sam
Sam Tran
VP, Procurement
Zephyr Labs
[Attachment: Vendor_Intake_Template.xlsx]

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Sam Tran <sam.tran@zephyrlabs.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, jordan_blake@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 15 Jan 2026 10:04:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: New vendor: banking + PO flow questions

Hi Sam — thanks, happy to own this on our side. Quick answers and a short checklist below.

Legal entity / tax
- Company name: Redwood Inference, Inc.
- EIN: 12-3456789
- W9: attaching when you confirm secure upload (we can DocuSign or send PDF)

Banking / remittance
- We can accept ACH or wire. For ACH we provide routing + account; for wire we provide beneficiary + SWIFT where required.
- Remittance string: we prefer PO# + invoice# + remit_to:finance@redwood.ai. Example: PO:ZGF-12345 | INV:2026-0007 | remit_to:finance@redwood.ai

PO / purchase order mapping
- We typically require PO number on invoice and include invoice-level custom fields: customer_id, project_code. If your ERP needs a specific field name mapping, send the CSV and Jordan will map it.

What we need from you (to proceed):
1) Send a copy of the bank letter or voided check (PDF).
2) Completed vendor intake form (the template).
3) Preferred remit label format for your AP system (a sample remittance file is ideal).

Attachments (we will send): Redwood_W9.pdf, PO-mapping-template.csv

Next steps: Once we have the bank letter + W9 we'll request micro-deposits verification (1–2 business days) and confirm when the vendor can be marked active. Jordan, can you take the PO mapping when Sam sends the sample file? Marissa, will you coordinate with finance operations on the micro-deposit timeline?

Thanks — Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Head of Partnerships (acting)
Redwood Inference
[Signature: k.iyer@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0173]

Sam

Team — forwarding Zephyr's docs. Bank letter shows account ending 4321 which matches the masked number in their intake. Can finance_ops queue micro-deposits for this account and confirm timing? They need vendor active in their ERP by EOD Jan 26.

Thanks — Marissa

From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>

Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai, logan_wright@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 19 Jan 2026 15:04:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Zephyr Labs: payee intake, PO field mapping & bank evidence

Sam — thanks for the quick turnaround and for sending the W9 and bank letter. Finance ops validated the bank letter against micro-deposits (two small credits: $0.12 and $0.37 visible this morning) and the account is verified.

What we did / next steps:
- Vendor status: Verified -> Active in Redwood ERP. You should be able to receive POs immediately.
- Remittance label: We created a remittance_key field that prepends the PO number to the remittance string and truncates to 20 characters where required. Example output: ZGF-12345|INV-2026-0007 -> "ZGF-12345|INV-" (first 20 chars)
- Please provide your first PO number (format / sample) and we'll ensure invoice ingestion from SPF is mapped correctly.

If procurement wants a final test PO, we can accept a $0 test PO and issue a credit/invoice to verify the full flow. Otherwise we will accept production POs and route remits to remit_to:finance@redwood.ai.

Cheers,
Jordan Blake
Billing & Receivables Lead
Redwood Inference
